enderskills.altar.title: Altar
enderskills.altar.reset.done: Skills reset. %s XP was stored in the altar.
enderskills.altar.reset.limit: You can't reset your skills any more.
enderskills.altar.not_yet: Its effect arrives in a next version of the port.
enderskills.altar.blocked.needs_starter: Needs the first skill of a tree of this class.
enderskills.altar.blocked.needs_previous: Needs the previous skill of this tree.
enderskills.altar.blocked.needs_power: The altar needs more power: place Crystal Blocks around it.
enderskills.altar.blocked.needs_ultimate: Needs an Ultimate Altar (drop an Ender Matrix on an altar).
enderskills.altar.blocked.needs_both: After the ultimate, needs both skills of the previous pair.
enderskills.altar.blocked.either_or: You chose the other skill of this pair (both are allowed after the ultimate).
enderskills.altar.blocked.levels: Your Ender Level is too low: use Ender Tokens.
enderskills.command.reset: Skills reset (spent XP stored in the altar).
skill.enderskills.charm.desc: Confuses a single enemy attracting it towards your position.
skill.enderskills.power_boost.desc: Boosts the ability strength of an ally.
skill.enderskills.nearby_invincibility.d: Grants invulnerability to all attacks except knockback to everyone in range including the user.
skill.enderskills.taunt.desc: Confuses enemies in an area attracting everyone towards your position.
skill.enderskills.wall.desc: Summons an impenetrable wall rising from the floor at great speeds.
skill.enderskills.dome.desc: Summons an impenetrable dome rising from the floor from all cardinal directions at great speeds.
skill.enderskills.thorny.desc: Deals damage back to the attacker from melee attacks.
skill.enderskills.shockwave.desc: Stuns and pushes everyone away in the affected area.
skill.enderskills.animated_stone_golem.d: Summons a golem to fight for you. [Applies Stun debuff]
skill.enderskills.shocking_aura.desc: While active, slows enemies in an area. Use again to switch it off; drains endurance every second.
skill.enderskills.electric_pulse.desc: Electrifies and slows enemies. [Applies Electric debuff]
skill.enderskills.magnetic_pull.desc: Pulls towards you and slows enemies.
skill.enderskills.power_drain.desc: Steal the endurance from all enemies around you.
skill.enderskills.energize.desc: Refills target ally's endurance with your own.
skill.enderskills.voltaic_sentinel.desc: Summons a sentinel to assist you and your teamates. [Applies Electric debuff]
skill.enderskills.flares.desc: Pulses homing flares that deal damage. Only fires 1 at a time. Switch on/off; drains endurance every second.
skill.enderskills.blazing_aura.desc: A toggle ability that will ignite nearby enemies within. Will re-apply ignite as soon as it wears off. Drains endurance every second.
skill.enderskills.ring_of_fire.desc: Places a one way ring of fire that locks who ever steps inside. Ignites as the entity enters the ring.
skill.enderskills.home_star.desc: Grants you and allies immunity to fire/lava. Also causes you and your allies to pulse heatwaves out in an AoE. This heatwave causes damage and applies ignite.
skill.enderskills.dash.desc: Dash in any horizontal direction: hold W/A/S/D and double tap the Dash key (Left Alt).
skill.enderskills.extra_jump.desc: Allows the user to jump on air.
skill.enderskills.fog.desc: Confuses the target by limiting viewing distance, removes aggro and targetting from mobs.
skill.enderskills.smash.desc: Crush the ground, stunning enemies and dealing the fall damage to them: hold sneak in the air.
skill.enderskills.hasten.desc: Reduces the cooldown of all abilities.
skill.enderskills.warp.desc: Teleport a short way in any direction: hold W/A/S/D and double tap the Dash key (Left Alt).
skill.enderskills.invisibility.desc: Grants the user an invisible layer, deactivates when hit.
skill.enderskills.hover.desc: Fall slowly for a while with no fall damage: press jump in the air and keep holding it.
skill.enderskills.unstable_portal.desc: Summons a portal that teleports randomly any living creature upon contact.
skill.enderskills.portal.desc: Portal gun: first use places the entrance, second the exit. They stay until you use it again. Range grows with the level.
skill.enderskills.teleport.desc: Allows the user to teleport towards the crosshair.
skill.enderskills.shadow.desc: Summons a shadow copy that mimics every attack once. Passive: works on melee hits (has a cooldown).
skill.enderskills.gloom.desc: Sends a quick long range beam of darkness at the enemy. It’ll hit them and quickly damage them over time.
skill.enderskills.shadow_jab.desc: Sends a quick stream of punches at the enemy. It’ll hit them and quickly damage them over time.
skill.enderskills.gas_cloud.desc: Summons a cloud of poisonous gas that explodes upon placement and slowly damages everyone over time.
skill.enderskills.grasp.desc: Summon a creature from the void to hold anyone in place in the selected area.
skill.enderskills.black_hole.desc: Summons a black hole that pulls enemies and slowly damages anyone near it over time.
skill.enderskills.bleed.desc: Gives all of your attacks the passive ability to bleed enemies. Passive: works on melee hits (has a cooldown).
skill.enderskills.blood_pool.desc: Toss blood onto the floor. This blood will slowly damage the entity who stands on it.
skill.enderskills.contaminate.desc: Spits up blood onto the enemy. It’ll slowly damage them over time.
skill.enderskills.life_steal.desc: Recovers your own health for melee attacks. Passive: works on melee hits (has a cooldown).
skill.enderskills.syphon.desc: Recovers your own health draining the target's.
skill.enderskills.sacrifice.desc: Consumes health but increases damage output.
skill.enderskills.slash.desc: The wind moves so fast that it causes a rip of damage at a distance. Using this ability sends out a swipe of air which goes through multiple enemies at once in a wide range.
skill.enderskills.push.desc: Pushes enemies away and stuns them.
skill.enderskills.pull.desc: Pulls enemies away and stuns them for 3 seconds.
skill.enderskills.crush.desc: Summons a wall of air that stuns the target and deals decent damage.
skill.enderskills.updraft.desc: Fling everyone up in the affected area.
skill.enderskills.suffocate.desc: Completely drain air from an area creating a void that damages over time and stops movement.
skill.enderskills.fire_spirit.desc: Gives all of your attacks the passive ability to burn enemies. Passive: works on melee hits (has a cooldown).
skill.enderskills.flaming_breath.desc: Summon a flame that burns on contact.
skill.enderskills.flaming_rain.desc: Summon a cloud to make fire rain down the enemy.
skill.enderskills.focus_flame.desc: Summon a whirling column of fire that incinerates everything on it.
skill.enderskills.fireball.desc: Summon a ball of fire that explodes and burns on contact.
skill.enderskills.explode.desc: Spontaneously combust with a powerful shockwave.
skill.enderskills.radiant_ray.desc: Sends down a ray of light at the target location from above. [Applies Glowing debuff, Triggers Glowing Effect]
skill.enderskills.lumen_wave.desc: A wave of light that goes forward from the player. Causing small knock up with minor stun. [Applies Glowing debuff, Triggers Glowing Effect]
skill.enderskills.gleam_flash.desc: A placeable AoE that explodes after a delay. [Applies Glowing debuff, Triggers Glowing Effect]
skill.enderskills.solar_lance.desc: Long range bolt with a very thin hit box. Pierces entities depending on level. [Applies Glowing debuff, Triggers Glowing Effect]
skill.enderskills.barrage_wisps.desc: Cone that sends out wisps that fire out and sit in the air for a delay, then home towards the target in front. [Applies Glowing debuff]
skill.enderskills.final_flash.desc: A charge beam that takes seconds to wind up. [Applies Glowing debuff]
skill.enderskills.black_flame_ball.desc: Throws a ball of raging black fire that explodes on hit After dealing damage it continues to sap foes' HP for a very short time. [Applies Black Flame]
skill.enderskills.black_scouring_flame.d: Sweeps a wide area before the caster with black flame. After dealing damage it continues to sap foes' HP for a very short time. [Applies Black Flame]
skill.enderskills.black_blessing_flame.d: Enhances the caster with the boon of the blackflame. allowing it to set the enemies ablaze on-damage that sap foes' HP for a very short time. [Applies Black Flame]
skill.enderskills.black_raging_flame_bal: Hurls a massive ball of raging blackfire. it will explode and set the area aflame. [Applies Black Flame]
skill.enderskills.black_volley_flame.des: The caster will shoot quickly a barrage of blackflame projectiles. [Applies Black Flame]
skill.enderskills.black_flare_flame.desc: Cast forth a shimmering orb that will be suspended in the air and then it will flash and detonate. setting everything aflame. [Applies Black Flame]
skill.enderskills.jump_height.desc: Increases the vertical velocity of every jump.
skill.enderskills.speed.desc: Increases the horizontal velocity of every step.
skill.enderskills.stealth_damage.desc: Deals extra damage when melee attacks are out of the target's field of view.
skill.enderskills.attack_speed.desc: Increases swing speed for all weapons, diminishing effects apply when using slow weapons or under the effects of fatigue.
skill.enderskills.knockback.desc: Inceases the force of knockback attacks.
skill.enderskills.critical_chance.desc: Increases the chance of dealing a crit.
skill.enderskills.armor_penetration.desc: Increases damage dealt to armored targets.
enderskills.config.title: Ender Skills
enderskills.config.ability_damage_multip: Multiplies damage and healing of every ability from level 0.
enderskills.config.max_level_overdrive.d: At its top level a skill is (1 + this) times stronger. 30 = 31x.
enderskills.config.overdrive_curve.desc: 1 = grows steadily, 3 = balanced early and huge only near the top level.
enderskills.config.tree_power.desc: Extra multiplier for this tree's abilities (1 = normal).
enderskills.config.portal_range_start.de: Most blocks between the two portals at level 0.
enderskills.config.portal_range_max.desc: Grows from the start value up to this at the top level (30,000,000 = whole world).
enderskills.config.portal_aim_range.desc: How far you can aim to place a portal.
enderskills.config.teleport_range_max.de: Long jumps load the chunks on the way.
enderskills.config.cost_increment.desc: Each tree you start later costs more.
enderskills.portal.too_far: Too far from the entrance (max %s blocks).
enderskills.config.portal_always_open.de: Off: below the top level portals close after the time below. You can always close them by using the ability again.
enderskills.config.portal_close_end: Portal lifetime before the top level (s)
enderskills.config.portal_close_end.desc: At the top level portals stay until you close them.
enderskills.config.coordinates.desc: Sneak and press the Portal or Teleport key to type X Y Z.
enderskills.config.teleport_ground.desc: You always land on the ground below the target.
enderskills.config.status_overlay.desc: Colored animated frame (like freezing) while you are stunned, electrified, rooted, bleeding...
enderskills.coords.title: Target coordinates
enderskills.command.unknown: Unknown skill for this command (use the suggestions).
enderskills.command.bad_level: The level must be a number or max.
enderskills.altar.book_mode: read anywhere · unlock at an altar
enderskills.altar.book_needs_altar: Use an altar to unlock or upgrade.
enderskills.altar.hint: Choose a class and a tree on the left, then hover or click a skill to see what it does and what it costs.
enderskills.config.sound_volume.desc: Volume of every Ender Skills sound.
enderskills.config.extra_sounds.desc: Abilities also play Minecraft sounds besides their original sound.
enderskills.config.vfx_density.desc: Amount of particles of the visual effects (lower for weak computers).
enderskills.config.skill_volume.desc: Volume of this ability's sound (1 = normal).
enderskills.config.creative_free.desc: In creative mode every skill can be unlocked and upgraded without cost or tree rules (also from the Ender Book).
